name: BSP_GunneryTargetRanks_Build
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_unit_gunnery_pass, read-only analysis. __cdecl(), RET 0, body 00727BD0-00727C24. Sole caller 004DDB90, the game singleton constructor. Inverts the twelve authored preference lists at 00E092C8 (61h class ids each, 0 meaning absent) into the rank table at 00E19BF8, writing the one-based position of each class id at [00E19BF8 + (classId + category*61h)*4] and leaving 0 for a class that is not listed. Lower rank is more preferred and 0 means never engage. docs/UNIT_GUNNERY_PASS.md | Packet cc2_gunnery_tables, read-only analysis: the source table at 00E092C8 is NOT zero in the image. .data is file-initialized from 00E08000 for 10000h bytes, so 00E092C8-00E0A4F8 is initialized storage and carries twelve authored rows of 61h dwords on a 184h stride; only the leading entries of each row are non-zero. There is no run-time producer: 00E092C8 appears exactly once in the whole image, as the MOV ESI immediate at 00727BDB. Category 0's single entry 61h is one past the class-id space, so its rank write at 00727BFB lands on 00E19BF8+184h, the first slot of row 1, which the next iteration's REP STOSD at 00727BEC zeroes before filling; the aliasing is therefore harmless.
